item.title: Nintendo’s Biggest Game of the Year Isn't What You Think It Is
item.description: This is the time of year when Nintendo's global marketing departments start limbering up and doing stretches for a big mass-market retail push. Nintendo UK launched a wholesome and emotive campaign this week, seemingly trying to one-up Nintendo Australia's legendary sad Zelda dad campaign for Tears of the Kingdom back in 2023. It doesn't quite work, but something about it caught my eye.

item.title: CBS's Legendary 156-Episode Sci-Fi Anthology Series is Officially Free to Watch on Streaming
item.description: In the realm of science fiction, Star Wars and Star Trek are generally considered to be the two biggest and most important franchises of all time. If you’re purely talking about profitability, that’s correct; those two have dominated TV and film for decades. However, if you factor in things like influence and impact, another sci-fi property ranks right up there with the big two. In the realm of sci-fi, pretty much all roads lead to, or derive from, The Twilight Zone . And this landmark show is currently free to stream.

item.title: 5 Must-Play New Xbox Games Coming in November, Including GTA 6
item.description: If you only took a quick glance at November’s release date calendar, you might walk away with the idea that Xbox players are only getting one game this month: Grand Theft Auto 6 . While that’s certainly the only big game coming to Series X, the first few weeks of November are deceptively crowded . A stack of indie hidden gems and nostalgic remasters are here to make sure you have something to play while you wait for your return to Vice City.

item.title: Sony's Bringing Back Spider-Man $2.5 Billion Hit With New Footage
item.description: As Marvel Studios' release of Avengers Endgame: Encore proves, blockbuster movies can still dominate the box office , even after a multibillion dollar run. Sony is reportedly planning a rerelease of Spider-Man: Brand New Day to bring web-head-heads back to movie theaters — and like Endgame: Encore , the studio is adding new footage of Spider-Man 's latest flick as an incentive.

item.title: 15 Classic Games That Prove Gameplay Is More Important Than Graphics
item.description: There’s no getting around it: graphics matter a great deal for video games. For many years, visual fidelity alone was one of the best reasons to invest in new consoles and better gaming PCs. There have always been games that didn’t compete for a position at the head of the pack, though. Their developers recognized the importance of compelling gameplay loops, fiendish difficulty, multiplayer appeal, and innovation long before such priorities reliably drew crowds.

item.title: Top 10 Pokémon Cards Most Likely to Be Fake
item.description: The more Pokémon trading cards pop off , the more potential players and collectors have to worry about one thing: counterfeit cards. Sometimes, a fake card will be obvious. As more money pours into the hobby , however, there's more incentive than ever to pull a fast one on people. Fakes are getting harder to tell from authentic ones, but it helps to know what Pokémon cards are the most likely targets — and what you should look out for in general while inspecting singles.

item.title: Every Mike Flanagan TV Series, Ranked
item.description: Mike Flanagan is certainly having a moment this year. After the success of Prime Video's Carrie — and its season two renewal — more eyes are on him and his works than ever before. Luckily, he has a fairly solid backlog of TV shows and films for viewers to peruse. In fact, hardly anybody is creating consistent, high-quality horror for film and television like Flanagan is.

item.title: 10 Free Browser Games That are Actually Fun to Play
item.description: If you do your research, though, you’ll find a treasure trove of easily-accessible gems — like a solo dev’s reworked Diablo village where you watch your party auto-battle its way through catacombs, or an idle game where managing catnip supply chains spirals into deep-space civilization management. Deduction mysteries, language-learning puzzles, and dungeon crawlers usually come with a price tag and a download bar. Tragically for your productivity and spare time, these ten do not.

item.title: Calvin and Hobbes' Final Strip is Still the Perfect Goodbye
item.description: On November 18, 1985, the very first comic strip of Calvin and Hobbes appeared in newspapers. “So long, pop! I’m off to check my tiger trap!” Calvin, wearing a safari helmet, said to his dad in the first panel. Calvin went on to explain that he rigged the trap with a tuna fish sandwich, something a tiger cannot resist. In the last panel, Hobbes is seen for the first time, hanging upside down in a tree, eating the sandwich.

item.title: 10 Essential NES Games Still Missing From Switch Online
item.description: The Nintendo Entertainment System is credited with rescuing a flailing industry back in the late ‘80s and early ‘90s. Over the years, hundreds of amazing games launched for the console, and many of the best and most memorable of them are now available to play on Nintendo Switch Online . However, dozens of other fantastic titles still haven’t reached the service, and that needs to change. Out of those dozens remaining, here are 10 NES games that still need to come to Switch Online as soon as possible.
